requirementCueLines: This page contains information on admission to UW Bothell’s Bachelor of Arts in Chemistry , Bachelor of Science in Chemistry (general option) , and Bachelor of Science in Chemistry (Biochemistry option) .
Applicants must complete each prerequisite with a minimum grade of 2.0 in each course.

In-progress prerequisites : students should wait to apply to the major until all prerequisite courses are complete and grades are officially logged in the UW system (i.e., official transcripts are evaluated if transferring in credits).
B CHEM 143/144 General Chemistry I w/ Lab (4 + 2 credits)
B CHEM 153/154 General Chemistry II w/ Lab (4 + 2 credits)
B CHEM 163/164 General Chemistry III w/ Lab (4 + 2 credits)
